# Kronus

> Kronus ("Kronus - Discipline Tracker") is a discipline and habit tracker for iPhone. It turns your goals into daily habits and shows you, day by day, whether you're actually doing them: XP for every completed habit, ranks, streaks, and weekly, monthly and yearly stats. Free to download on the App Store, with an optional Kronus Premium subscription.

## What it does

- Build your system: pick habits from a ready-made library or create your own. Schedule them on specific weekdays, days of the month, a number of times per week or month, or every few days.
- Execute every day: check off each habit, set reminders at the times that matter, run timers for habits that take focus.
- Level up: every completed habit earns XP, a fully completed day earns a bonus, and you climb through ranks while keeping streaks alive. Vacation mode pauses habits for a planned break without breaking the streak.
- Stats: consistency for every week, month and year, so you can spot what's holding you back.
- Community: share wins, setbacks and what's working, and stay accountable.

## Who it's for

People who want discipline, not motivation: builders, athletes, students, entrepreneurs, and anyone tired of starting over who wants a clear system for daily execution. Common goals: gym and body, money and career, quitting bad habits (such as porn, vaping or doomscrolling), confidence and dating.

## Key facts

- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Not on Android yet.
- Price: free to download. Kronus Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription; prices and any free trial are shown in the app before purchase. Cancel any time in iPhone Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760615998
- Website: https://www.kronusdiscipline.com/
- Support: pedromppinto.mail@gmail.com
